newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Merck profit up after nine-months.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Merck profit up after nine-months.

text.p: German pharmaceutical group Merck KGaA said on Wednesday nine-month profits and turnover rose, with much of the increase coming from its activities in the Americas.
Profit from ordinary activities in the first nine months of the year rose 25 percent to 577 million marks ($383.9 million) on turnover up nearly 10 percent at 5.16 billion marks.
Profit after tax of 365 million marks already nearly matched that of the whole of last year, it said in a statement.
Merck cited the good performance of its north American business, where strong demand for pharmaceuticals helped turnover to an increase of 18 percent.
Sales gains in Europe and Asia were more modest, both rising some seven percent.
